today.title: Today
today.kickLabel: Click when you feel a kick
today.kickHint: Stays in the menu bar · Shortcut {shortcut} · Closing the window doesn’t quit
today.emptyTimeline:
No records yet.
Tap the button in the middle to start.
today.sessionNote: Pick a time when your baby is usually active and focus on the kicks. Count rolling movements within 1 minute as 1 kick. Reach your goal to finish today’s count.
today.baselineEmpty:
Need at least 1 day of records to establish a baseline.
Keep logging for a few days to see if today is similar to usual.
today.baselineLow: About {pct}% of usual, still close to your usual

alert.anomalyBody:
Today {today} kicks, {diff}% below your 7-day baseline ({base} kicks/day).
Try lying on your left side and focusing for 1–2 hours; if kicks stay low or stop, contact your obstetrician immediately.
alert.anomalyNote: This alert is for reference only, not a medical diagnosis.
alert.eveningBody: Consider starting a 2-hour counting session below to record today’s activity.

toast.sessionStart: Session started · Click the middle button when you feel a kick

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Logging & reminders
settings.dueDateDesc: Used to calculate gestational week, shown in the sidebar and mini window
settings.modeDesc: Mini window: a floating circle that stays on top. Closing the full window keeps this mode next time.
settings.shortcutDesc: Press anywhere to log a kick, even outside the app
settings.mergeDesc: Clicks within 1 minute count as 1 kick (standard counting rule)
settings.dailyRemindDesc: A daily nudge to count kicks
settings.anomalyRemindDesc: Alert when today’s count is below 50% of your baseline
settings.exportDesc: Stored locally as JSON · Export CSV for prenatal visits
settings.mobileEntryDesc: When your phone and computer are on the same Wi‑Fi, open the pairing link in your phone browser
settings.themeDesc: Choose a theme. Follow system uses your operating system preference.

week.notSetHint: Add your due date in Settings to see gestational week and countdown

mini.mergedBody: Rolling kicks within 1 minute count as 1
mini.guide: Click to log · Drag to move

disclaimer.footer: BabyBump is for tracking and trends only, not a medical diagnosis. If movements drop sharply or stop, contact your obstetrician right away.

pwa.subtitle: Log kicks on your phone
pwa.hint:
Tap when you feel a kick
Kicks within 1 minute are merged
pwa.dialogDesc: Make sure your phone and computer are on the same Wi‑Fi, then open the link below in your phone browser. It includes a pairing token — don’t share it.
